steps.title: Initialize Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish LuminaCalc package configuration, assets identity, and environment configurations.

steps.title: Configure Build Engine & Gradle Scripts
steps.description: Specify compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and pure Java 8 language compliance without third-party libraries.

steps.title: Configure Application Schemas
steps.description: Setup offline calculation metadata schema and local runtime configuration definitions.

steps.title: Assemble Android Manifest
steps.description: Register single-activity launcher with hardware acceleration and standard Material theme.

steps.title: Establish Dark Luxe Palette & Themes
steps.description: Create custom color palette featuring dark sapphire slate, neon cyan accents, amber warning hues, and button states.

steps.title: Design Interactive Keypad & Card Drawables
steps.description: Design custom rounded drawables with state selectors for digit, operator, function, action, and equal buttons.

steps.title: Construct Calculator Main Screen Layout
steps.description: Build modern responsive interface with live expression screen, real-time result preview, scientific function drawer, and grid keypad.

steps.title: Create Calculation History Dialog & Item Layouts
steps.description: Create dialog and row items for calculation logs with copy-to-screen and clear-history controls.

steps.title: Implement Calculation Record Model
steps.description: Implement data model for parsed mathematical records and history serialization.

steps.title: Implement Local History Storage Manager
steps.description: Implement local persistence manager to store, recall, and clear past calculations using SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Implement Calculation History Adapter
steps.description: Create list adapter to populate past math operations with recall action listeners.

steps.title: Implement Native High-Precision Math Engine
steps.description: Develop calculation engine supporting standard arithmetic, operator precedence, percentages, powers, square roots, factorials, and division by zero protection.

steps.title: Wire Controller and Interactive Logic in MainActivity
steps.description: Implement button inputs, haptic feedback, real-time preview computation, scientific expander, and history dialog interaction.

steps.title: Building LuminaCalc
steps.description: Assemble and compile debug APK package for LuminaCalc Android application.
